title: Create and Test a ClusterIP Service
description: Deploy a simple app and access it internally via a Service.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
Deploy an nginx Pod (via Deployment) and create a ClusterIP Service to access it from another Pod.

### Steps
1. Create a file `nginx-deploy.yaml` for a Deployment with name `nginx-svc-demo`, 1 replica, image `nginx:1.25`, label `app: nginx`.
2. Apply it: `kubectl apply -f nginx-deploy.yaml`.
3. Create a Service file `nginx-clusterip.yaml`:
   - type: ClusterIP
   - selector: `app: nginx`
   - port: 80, targetPort: 80
   - name: `nginx-svc`
4. Apply the Service: `kubectl apply -f nginx-clusterip.yaml`.
5. Verify the Service: `kubectl get svc nginx-svc`. Note the ClusterIP.
6. Run a temporary debug Pod: `kubectl run -it --rm debug --image=busybox --restart=Never -- sh`.
7. Inside the debug Pod, run `wget -O- http://nginx-svc` or `wget -O- http://<ClusterIP>`. You should see the nginx welcome page.
8. Exit and the debug Pod is deleted automatically.
hints: Use `kubectl get pods -l app=nginx -o wide` to see the Pod IP; compare with the Service endpoints (`kubectl get endpoints nginx-svc`).
If `wget` is not available in busybox, use `nslookup nginx-svc` to at least verify DNS resolution.
You can also use `curl` if you use an image like `curlimages/curl`.
expectedOutput: The debug Pod can fetch the nginx page via the Service name or ClusterIP.
solutionCode:
# nginx-deploy.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-svc-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.25
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
# nginx-clusterip.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
  type: ClusterIP
